milestone: GA-UX-PREMIUM M3.2 — runtime patch evidence contract repair

openApiContractShape.detail: OpenCode 1.18.27 pinned OpenAPI (packages/opencode-runtime/openapi/opencode.openapi.json): GET /session/{sessionID}/diff → SnapshotFileDiff[] { additions, deletions, file?, patch?: string, status? }; /vcs/diff → VcsFileDiff[] { additions, deletions, file, patch?: string, status? }. The server contract exposes patch as a STRING; there are no structured hunk fields (oldStart/oldLines/newStart/newLines/content).

normalizerFixture.detail: normalizeDiff now models the real server shape: file: string → path, status → operation, additions/deletions preserved, patch?: string preserved verbatim; no fabricated hunks: [] (packages/opencode-runtime/__tests__/session.test.ts). Shared normalizer: patch bounded (patchContent 20_000), patchTruncated on loss, diffRepresentation patch|hunks|unavailable derived truthfully (packages/shared/__tests__/assistant-execution.test.ts M3.2 block).

livePopulatedPatch.detail: GET /session/:id/diff returned [] for untracked, git-staged, and tracked-file edits (polled 60s after idle); session.diff events fired with diff: Array(0); edit tool part reported "Edit applied successfully." with no patch. No populated runtime patch response could be produced safely in this environment — nothing was fabricated.

liveEmptyDiff.detail: Live server returns an empty session diff ([]). The contract handles it: empty diff → no turn-end edit detail (or file.edited events with diffRepresentation: 'unavailable'); missing patch → patch absent, representation unavailable. See docs/blueprint/GA-UX-PREMIUM-M3.1-live-evidence.json.

contractRepair.status: IMPLEMENTED + TESTED (257 tests incl. SSE propagation)
contractRepair.extension: EditExecutionDetail.patch?: string; patchTruncated?: boolean; diffRepresentation: 'patch' | 'hunks' | 'unavailable' (additive; hunks retained)
contractRepair.bounds: patchContent 20_000 centralized in ASSISTANT_EXECUTION_BOUNDS (rationale: no SSE frame cap exists; 4x the 8000 hunk aggregate; deterministic truncation flagged via patchTruncated)
contractRepair.provenance: diffProvenance now derived from actual carried evidence (patch or hunks → runtime-provided; neither → unavailable); diffRepresentation lets consumers distinguish runtime patch vs runtime structured hunks vs unavailable
contractRepair.invariant: patch present → runtime patch; hunks present → runtime structured hunks; neither → unavailable. Never converted.
contractRepair.sanitization: construct-never-clone preserved; unknown fields excluded; 'Edit applied successfully.' result text never becomes a patch
contractRepair.ssePropagation: proven: StreamChunk.detail → ConversationChunk.event.execution carries patch AND hunks (conversations.test.ts)
